name: @ismail-elkorchi/verge-browser
description: A terminal web browser with semantic HTML rendering and reusable browsing primitives.

scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run smoke:node && npm run test:fuzz
scripts.check:core: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke:cli
scripts.jsr:check: deno check --no-lock --sloppy-imports jsr/mod.ts && deno doc --lint --no-lock --sloppy-imports jsr/mod.ts && deno test --doc --no-lock --sloppy-imports jsr/mod.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run release:clean-install && npm run check:core && npm run jsr:check && npm run examples:run && npm run smoke:all && npm run test:fuzz:release && npm run release:package
scripts.smoke:all: npm run smoke:node && npm run smoke:deno && npm run smoke:bun && node scripts/smoke/check-runtime-parity.mjs
scripts.smoke:deno: npm run build && deno run --allow-read --allow-write=reports --allow-env --node-modules-dir=manual scripts/smoke/runtime-smoke.mjs --runtime=deno --report=reports/smoke-deno.json
